source: M03 §6.4 with the v3 business rules (Oct 2026), M21 §6.1 and M01 §6.4; v2 adds the M04 events.* and audit.* operations keys; v3 the M08 notify.* keys; v4 the M06 payments.* and refunds.retry_max keys; v5 the M07 payouts.min_amount_poisha, auto_release_max_poisha, run_hour and daily_enabled keys, and payments.test_charge_max_poisha 100000 (৳1,000, so a test charge can clear the ৳100 payout minimum; existing databases keep their value); v6 the M02 kyc.uploads_per_hour and kyc.orphan_upload_hours keys; v7 the M05 moderation.review_sla_warn_hours, claim_max_min, heartbeat_sec, apply_timeout_minutes and apply_max_attempts keys; v8 the M21 esports.dispute_max_per_entry and room_reads_per_minute keys; v9 the M09 ground.min_photos, max_photos, photo_max_bytes, photo_uploads_per_hour, duplicate_radius_m and closure_max_days_ahead keys; v10 the M10 booking.hold_attempts_per_10min, walkin_auto_checkin_min, availability_cache_seconds, balance_unrecorded_days and start_reminder_hours keys (booking.owner_confirm_window_min stays seeded but is unused: bookings confirm instantly, Q66); v11 the M19 analytics.week_start, mview_refresh_minutes, reconcile_days, drift_alert_pct, export_sync_max_rows and exports_per_hour keys; v12 the M17 disputes.*, reports.* and reviews.* keys; v13 the M18 risk.* and trust.* keys (the existing risk.* names are kept). Money in poisha, percentages as numbers. v14 adds the M12 step-1 market keys (product photos and upload limits, the re-review price threshold, made-to-order and per-order defaults, saved items); v15 adds the M13 step-1 order keys (checkout hold, cart line age, ship-overdue cancel windows, the accept reminder) and disputes.window_order_hours; v16 adds the M11 step-1 hire keys (payment window, reply and payment cut-offs before the start, cancellation tier hours, no-show time, match lengths, engagements per request, messages per hour, shortlist size); v17 adds the M20 step-1 gym keys (day pass limits, how far ahead, month and quarter days, photos, trainer subscription days, start, cancel and renewal windows, plan price limits) and disputes.window_trainer_hours; v18 adds the M22 step-1 organiser SaaS keys (invoice due days, overdue grace, reserved subdomains, VAT switch and rate, contract expiry notice); v19 adds the M23 step-1 big event keys (qualifying gap, core players, final reminder, alert cooldown and fan-out batch, poll options, pushes and cache, feed page size, stage and sponsor limits, banner size, viewer actions per minute); v20 adds the M16 step-1 team keys (invite expiry, members per team, teams per member, invites per day, resend cooldown; category tournament); v21 adds the M14 step-1 tournament keys (payment hold, reserve offer, refund after close, entry fee cap, team cap, days before the first match, rules relock, console actions per minute). v22: user-facing words Grounds → Venues, Tournaments → Events, big events → Showcases (19 Oct 2026).
